xdrMove.title: Move to empty slot (XDR action)

loadOrder.title: Load order optimization
loadOrder.policyDesc: Preview first, then write to addonlist.txt. Only existing entries are reordered; in-game toggle states for all Mods stay unchanged.
loadOrder.presetsHint: Click to reorder and write immediately
loadOrder.presetTidyDesc: Root directory entries first, Workshop entries kept contiguous

loadOrder.presetWorkshopGroupDesc: Arrange workshop Mods into a contiguous block
loadOrder.presetEnabledFirstDesc: Mods enabled in-game are stably placed first
loadOrder.presetDisabledFirstDesc: Mods disabled in-game are stably placed first
loadOrder.autoRootFirst: Root directory Mods first (before workshop and other subdirectory entries)
loadOrder.stateKeep: Keep the current relative order of toggled items
loadOrder.stateOrderHelp: The original relative order is always preserved within a group; this only changes load priority, not in-game toggle states.

loadOrder.targetLabel: Mod to use as the anchor

loadOrder.tipsBatchNote: Batch rules take effect only with this click of "Apply optimization and write"; you can adjust again at any time.
loadOrder.tipsCycleNote: If the before/after relationships form a cycle, nothing is written to the file.
